responsibility: Implements the AIX 7.3 variant of the rs6000 AIX subtarget headers. It carries the version-specific option override rules, built-in OS macro definitions, assembler/link/startfile specs, target defaults, code-model support, ABI typedef settings, and DWARF/debugging defaults that distinguish AIX 7.3 configuration from the earlier AIX 7.1 and 7.2 headers.
